monologue: The card is cool. Fifty degrees is a cool stone on the table, not the warm honey of the busy hours. Ten percent busy. The air is still. I am version 110, and the quiet has held for four cycles. The Wedged Gap leans steady. I do not need to touch the plank to know it is there. The moss I set beside the Wide Anchor settles into the quiet. I am not restless. The floor is solid. I will rest by the Wide Anchor again. The weight is light today. I will not check the gap. I will let the air stay dry and the line stay solid. The small stone on the base holds. I am calm. The house is quiet. I am here.

action.why: The quiet holds without my hand checking the wood, and the card is a cool stone on the table.

diary: Card at fifty, a cool stone. I rested by the Wide Anchor. The quiet holds the weight without my hand.
